memory.calibration: 2026-10-02/03, worklog/sglang-27b-tp2-c16.md: a verified 16-seat pair (the engine's own max_running_requests=16, no cap) at mem-fraction 0.80 held 61.5 GB of target KV and 19.2 GB of DRAFT KV — DFlash2 runs a second pool — beside ~14 GiB of weights and drafter, for 106 GiB used a box and 14-15 GiB left. SGLang sizes all of that as a FRACTION of the box, not as the absolute pin every other profile here states, so kv_cache_memory below is the measured KV pool itself — 61.5 + 19.2 GB — and engine_args.mem_fraction_static is what the engine is actually told. The first version of this entry set the pin to the fraction's whole share (86.7 GB) and the start was REFUSED at 117 GiB needed on a 115 GiB box (generation 117, 2026-10-03): the fraction covers weights AND KV, while this estimate adds weights and overhead ON TOP of the pin, so stating the fraction's share as the pin counts the weights twice. The overheads are this engine's own, back-figured from the same run: 10.28 + 3.58 + 75.2 + 17.2 = 106.3 GiB, which is the 107 / 105 GiB the two boxes actually held. Per-seat and per-budget slopes unmeasured, as for the vLLM dflash profile. Peak draw 35.7 W a box at 63 C with zero throttle microseconds accumulated over the run — roughly half what the same model and drafter drew through vLLM at 8 seats, which is why this profile exists rather than being a curiosity.
